experiments.name: GMP controlled-rate cryopreservation of a gene-modified CD34+ HSC drug product (Kryo 560-16 three-ramp program: 4 C hold, -1/-2/-20 C/min to -180 C) before vapour-phase LN2 storage
experiments.plain_name: Freeze a gene-therapy stem-cell bag with a programmed three-step cooling recipe
experiments.description: Clinical-grade freezing of a lentivirally corrected hematopoietic stem cell product (MPSII gene therapy) in cryobags: the controlled-rate freezer holds 4 C, cools at -1 C/min to -30 C, -2 C/min to -60 C and -20 C/min to -180 C; the product then goes to vapour-phase liquid nitrogen at -130 C or colder.

requirements.rationale: The freezing program starts with a 4 C hold and ends with a hold at -180 C, so the chamber must cover -180 C to +4 C.
requirements.document_title: Design and validation of a GMP stem cell manufacturing protocol for MPSII hematopoietic stem cell gene therapy (Ellison et al., Mol Ther Methods Clin Dev 2024)
requirements.quote: Cryopreservation protocol (Kryo 560-16 controlled rate freezer): Hold at 4°C for 5 min, first ramp cools at a rate of −1°C/min to −30°C, second ramp cools at a rate of −2°C/min to −60°C, and ramp three cools at a rate of −20°C/min to −180°C.

requirements.rationale: The program imposes controlled cooling-rate magnitudes of 1, 2 and 20 C/min, so the freezer must control rates from 1 to 20 C/min.
requirements.document_title: Design and validation of a GMP stem cell manufacturing protocol for MPSII hematopoietic stem cell gene therapy (Ellison et al., Mol Ther Methods Clin Dev 2024)
requirements.quote: Cryopreservation protocol (Kryo 560-16 controlled rate freezer): Hold at 4°C for 5 min, first ramp cools at a rate of −1°C/min to −30°C, second ramp cools at a rate of −2°C/min to −60°C, and ramp three cools at a rate of −20°C/min to −180°C.

requirements.rationale: Lowest program temperature is -180 C (same information as temperature.range, for machines that only document a base temperature).
requirements.document_title: Design and validation of a GMP stem cell manufacturing protocol for MPSII hematopoietic stem cell gene therapy (Ellison et al., Mol Ther Methods Clin Dev 2024)
requirements.quote: Hold at −180°C until unloaded into VPLN upon completion of program.

requirements.rationale: Subsequent storage is in vapour-phase LN2 at -130 C or colder (a separate storage step; informative for the freezing machine).
requirements.document_title: Design and validation of a GMP stem cell manufacturing protocol for MPSII hematopoietic stem cell gene therapy (Ellison et al., Mol Ther Methods Clin Dev 2024)
requirements.quote: The cryopreserved product, in volumes of 20 ± 2.5 mL, is then stored in the vapor phase of LN 2 (VPLN) at a temperature of −130°C or less.

sources.citation: Design and validation of a GMP stem cell manufacturing protocol for MPSII hematopoietic stem cell gene therapy (Ellison et al., Mol Ther Methods Clin Dev 2024). DOI 10.1016/j.omtm.2024.101271

experiments.name: Public cord-blood-unit banking: controlled-rate freezing in 10% DMSO and long-term storage in the liquid phase of liquid nitrogen at -196 C
experiments.plain_name: Bank umbilical cord blood for transplants in liquid nitrogen
experiments.description: Red-cell- and plasma-depleted cord blood units with DMSO/dextran cryoprotectant are frozen at a controlled rate and stored (up to 19 years) immersed in liquid nitrogen at -196 C, well below the ~-130 C glass transition of water.

requirements.rationale: Units are stored immersed in the liquid phase of liquid nitrogen at -196 C.
requirements.document_title: Up to 19-year cryopreservation does not impair hematopoietic progenitor function in cord blood: a 1129-unit analysis from the largest Korean public cord blood bank (Roh et al., Stem Cells Transl Med)
requirements.location: Materials and methods, cord blood processing
requirements.quote: After cryoprotectant addition, units underwent controlled-rate freezing and were stored in the liquid phase of liquid nitrogen at −196 °C.

requirements.rationale: Liquid-phase storage requires a vessel that holds liquid nitrogen.
requirements.document_title: Up to 19-year cryopreservation does not impair hematopoietic progenitor function in cord blood: a 1129-unit analysis from the largest Korean public cord blood bank (Roh et al., Stem Cells Transl Med)
requirements.location: Materials and methods, cord blood processing
requirements.quote: After cryoprotectant addition, units underwent controlled-rate freezing and were stored in the liquid phase of liquid nitrogen at −196 °C.

requirements.rationale: Physical basis: below the ~-130 C glass transition of water biological activity stops; informative lower bound for any acceptable store.
requirements.document_title: Up to 19-year cryopreservation does not impair hematopoietic progenitor function in cord blood: a 1129-unit analysis from the largest Korean public cord blood bank (Roh et al., Stem Cells Transl Med)
requirements.quote: Below the glass transition temperature of water (∼−130 °C), molecular-level biological activity ceases, and cryopreserved cells can theoretically be stored indefinitely.

experiments.name: Ultra-low-temperature storage of frozen Pfizer-BioNTech COMIRNATY (KP.2) mRNA vaccine vials at -90 C to -60 C
experiments.plain_name: Keep mRNA vaccine vials frozen in an ultra-cold freezer
experiments.description: Vaccine-depot storage: frozen vials are kept in an ultra-low-temperature (ULT) freezer between -90 C and -60 C until expiry and must not be stored at -25 C to -15 C; thawed vials go to a 2-8 C fridge for up to 10 weeks.

requirements.rationale: The storage space must reach -60 C or colder (warm edge of the permitted -90 C to -60 C window).
requirements.document_title: Ontario Ministry of Health, Chapter 1: Storage and Handling of Pfizer-BioNTech's COVID-19 Vaccines, Version 8.0 (October 22, 2024)

requirements.quote: Store at ultra-low temperature freezer at -90°C to -60°C until printed expiry date or otherwise noted.

requirements.rationale: The storage space must also be settable no colder than -90 C (cold edge of the window); with the previous requirement the machine range must overlap -90 C to -60 C, which excludes nitrogen storage that only runs far below -90 C.
requirements.document_title: Ontario Ministry of Health, Chapter 1: Storage and Handling of Pfizer-BioNTech's COVID-19 Vaccines, Version 8.0 (October 22, 2024)

requirements.rationale: Same -60 C limit for machines that document only their lowest temperature (portable ULT units qualify).

experiments.name: Long-term frozen storage of 40% (wt/vol) glycerol red blood cell units at -80 C (FDA/AABB: frozen at -65 C or colder, up to 10 years)
experiments.plain_name: Store rare-type donor red cells frozen for a decade
experiments.description: Rare-phenotype RBC units cryopreserved in 40% wt/vol glycerol are kept in a mechanical freezer at -80 C for 10 years or more, then thawed and deglycerolized; the AABB/FDA circular requires freezing at -65 C or colder.

requirements.rationale: The approved high-glycerol method stores the units at -80 C.

requirements.rationale: Regulatory limit: frozen RBCs are frozen and kept at -65 C or colder.

experiments.name: Rapid freezing of fresh frozen plasma in a contact shock freezer (core -30 C within 1 h, freezer at -50 C) and frozen storage at -40 C
experiments.plain_name: Quick-freeze donated plasma so its clotting factors survive
experiments.description: Blood-bank FFP preparation: plasma bags are frozen in a contact shock freezer operating at -50 C so the core reaches -30 C within 40 min (guideline: within 1 h), then kept stacked in a -40 C deep freezer; AABB requires -18 C or colder.

requirements.rationale: Plasma must be brought to a core temperature of -30 C or below, so the freezer must reach -30 C or colder.
requirements.document_title: A study on factors influencing the hemostatic potential of fresh frozen plasma (Dhantole, Dubey, Sonker; Asian J Transfus Sci 2019)
requirements.quote: Thus, by bringing core temperature to −30°C or below within 1 h, factor VIII activity is preserved.

requirements.rationale: Regulatory minimum for FFP: frozen at -18 C or colder.
requirements.document_title: Circular of Information for the Use of Human Blood and Blood Components (AABB, American Red Cross, America's Blood Centers, Armed Services Blood Program)

requirements.quote: FFP is prepared from a whole blood or apheresis collection and frozen at −18 C or colder within the time frame specified in the manufacturer's instructions for use

requirements.rationale: Operating point used for storage in the study: -40 C deep freezer (any -18 C or colder store meets the AABB rule).
requirements.document_title: A study on factors influencing the hemostatic potential of fresh frozen plasma (Dhantole, Dubey, Sonker; Asian J Transfus Sci 2019)
requirements.quote: For studying the effect of donor variables, plasma units under study were frozen instantaneously by contact shock freezer (CSF) (Dometic MBF 21, Luxembourg) and were stored at −40°C in stack position for 2 weeks in deep freezer (M/S Sanyo, Japan).

requirements.rationale: The contact shock freezer used operates at -50 C, which achieved the -30 C core in 40 min.

experiments.name: Whole-head 150-channel LTS-SQUID magnetoencephalography in a magnetically shielded room with a liquid-helium helmet dewar kept at 4.2 K by a 1.4 W pulse-tube reliquefier

experiments.description: MEG of spontaneous brain activity: low-Tc SQUID gradiometers in the vacuum space of a 90 L liquid-helium helmet dewar inside a magnetically shielded room; evaporated helium is reliquefied continuously by a Cryomech PT415RM (1.4 W at 4.2 K), giving 3.5 fT/rtHz white noise.

requirements.rationale: The SQUID gradiometers are cooled by the liquid-helium helmet at 4.2 K.

experiments.name: Renal cryoablation with an argon Joule-Thomson system (argon 4,300 psi, double 10-minute freeze, helium active thaw at 2,200 psi, -40 C isotherm)
experiments.plain_name: Destroy kidney tumour tissue by freezing it with an argon probe

experiments.plain_name: Give a patient a short session in an extremely cold therapy room
experiments.description: Clinical-trial adjunct to obesity management: 28 supervised whole-body cryotherapy sessions in a Univers Cryo-Combi three-chamber system, brief precooling at -30 C and -60 C followed by 3-4 min at -110 C; the person breathes the cold air at ambient pressure.

requirements.rationale: The chamber system must provide -30 C and -60 C precooling and the -110 C treatment chamber.
requirements.document_title: Effects of Whole-Body Cryotherapy Combined With Conventional Obesity Management Versus Obesity Management Alone: A Clinical Trial (Karppinen et al., Obesity 2025)
requirements.quote: Supervised sessions included brief precooling in −30°C and −60°C chambers, followed by 3–4 min in a −110°C chamber.

requirements.rationale: The patient is exposed to cold air; an evacuated sample space cannot host a person.
requirements.document_title: Effects of Whole-Body Cryotherapy Combined With Conventional Obesity Management Versus Obesity Management Alone: A Clinical Trial (Karppinen et al., Obesity 2025)
requirements.quote: Whole‐body cryotherapy (WBC), one of various forms of cold treatments, involves brief exposures (1–4 min) to extremely cold air (−110°C to −160°C).

requirements.rationale: Treatment-chamber temperature of about -110 C (second clinical source, chronic-pain patients).
requirements.document_title: Analgesia by Cryotherapy in Patients with Chronic Pain with Analysis of Pain-Modulating and Pro-Inflammatory Parameters - A Clinical Controlled Pilot Study (Ritter et al., J Clin Med 2025)
requirements.quote: The majority of the cryotherapy takes place in the third, at approximately −110 °C up to 3 min.

experiments.plain_name: Ship frozen cell-therapy vials between countries in a nitrogen dry shipper
experiments.description: Clinical-trial supply chain: GMP fetal-liver MSC vials stored at -150 C are shipped from Sweden to India by courier in a vapour-phase LN2 dry shipper with a data logger; temperature had to stay below -130 C; transits took 56 h to 178 h, arrival temperatures -193/-194 C.

requirements.rationale: Acceptance criterion: below -130 C throughout the transport.
requirements.document_title: Successful transport across continents of GMP-manufactured and cryopreserved culture-expanded human fetal liver-derived mesenchymal stem cells for use in a clinical trial (Kumar et al., Regen Ther 2024)
requirements.quote: The temperature had to be lower than −130 °C throughout the transport.

requirements.rationale: The container must hold temperature without refill or power for the longest observed transit (178 h).
requirements.document_title: Successful transport across continents of GMP-manufactured and cryopreserved culture-expanded human fetal liver-derived mesenchymal stem cells for use in a clinical trial (Kumar et al., Regen Ther 2024)
requirements.quote: The time for the three transports from site to site were 56 h and 12 min, 76 h and 17 min and 178 h (7 days), respectively.

requirements.rationale: Transport is in the vapour phase of liquid nitrogen held in the dry shipper.
requirements.document_title: Successful transport across continents of GMP-manufactured and cryopreserved culture-expanded human fetal liver-derived mesenchymal stem cells for use in a clinical trial (Kumar et al., Regen Ther 2024)
requirements.quote: The transport was performed in the vapour phase of liquid nitrogen in a dry shipper provided by the courier at less than −150 °C via air carriage and ground freight.

requirements.rationale: Shipper used was validated to keep -150 C or colder for 12 days (informative).
requirements.document_title: Successful transport across continents of GMP-manufactured and cryopreserved culture-expanded human fetal liver-derived mesenchymal stem cells for use in a clinical trial (Kumar et al., Regen Ther 2024)

notes: Healthcare and medicine experiment profiles (10). Celsius converted exactly to mK ((C+273.15)x1000). Not duplicated: existing oocyte Cryotop vitrification, intercostal cryoneurolysis, breast-cell freeze-thaw, PBMC controlled-rate freezing and OCT cryosectioning profiles. Storage procedures use temperature.range at_most (machine reaches the storage temperature or colder); the mRNA vaccine window -90..-60 C is encoded as at_most -60 C plus at_least -90 C (range overlap). Psi values (cryoablation 4,300/2,200 psi) are kept only in quotes, not converted. Tavily quota was exhausted; sources read via WebFetch, pdftotext of the fetched PDFs and Europe PMC full text.
